steps.name: Check if hash was updated
steps.run:
if git diff --quiet test/e2e/flake.nix; then
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Commit and push updated hash
steps.run:
/usr/bin/git config --local user.name "supabase-autofix-bot"
/usr/bin/git config --local user.email "noreply@supabase.com"
/usr/bin/git add test/e2e/flake.nix

if /usr/bin/git diff --cached --quiet; then
  exit 0
fi

/usr/bin/git commit -m "chore: update nix node_modules hash"
/usr/bin/git -c credential.helper= push "https://x-access-token:${APP_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" "HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH}"

pipelines.name: Flaky Test Digest

steps.name: List and download outstanding flaky artifacts
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p flaky-artifacts
: > matched_artifacts.jsonl

# Repo-wide `.../actions/artifacts` returns every artifact ever
# created, including coverage-partition-* (which this workflow
# never deletes) - so paginating that directly would still mean
# scanning up to 90 days of history every run, deletion or not.
# Scope to runs instead: list tests.yml runs from a generous fixed
# lookback then each run's own small list.
SINCE="$(date -u -d '7 days ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
RUN_IDS="$(gh run list --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --workflow=tests.yml \
  --created ">=${SINCE}" -L 1000 --json databaseId --jq '.[].databaseId')"

for RUN_ID in $RUN_IDS; do
  gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}/artifacts?per_page=100" \
    | jq -c '.artifacts[] | select(.expired == false) | select(.name | startswith("flaky-"))' \
    >> matched_artifacts.jsonl
done

jq -r '.id' matched_artifacts.jsonl > artifact_ids.txt || true

if [ ! -s matched_artifacts.jsonl ]; then
  echo "No outstanding flaky artifacts"
  exit 0
fi

while read -r ARTIFACT_ID; do
  curl -sSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}/zip" \
    -o "flaky-artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}.zip"
  unzip -o -q "flaky-artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}.zip" -d "flaky-artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}"
done < artifact_ids.txt

steps.name: Aggregate by file:line and build reports
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

find flaky-artifacts -name 'flaky-events.jsonl' -exec cat {} + > all_events.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true

if [ ! -s all_events.jsonl ]; then
  echo "has_events=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No flaky test or wait margin occurrences to report today." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  exit 0
fi

# Builds one Slack section block, and in parallel one markdown section for the run's
# step summary, per distinct file:line - instead of one giant string - so a snippet
# truncation can only ever clip that one entry, never the whole message/summary, and
# so markdown isn't nested inside an outer code fence that disables it.
#
# postgres/partition/job_url may be absent from previous runs or `job_url` failures
# - every use below tolerates that via `// ""`/`// empty`.
AGGREGATED_JSON="$(jq -sc --argjson max_entries 10 --argjson max_margin_entries 10 --argjson max_job_links 5 '
  def truncate_at_line($budget):
    if (. | length) <= $budget then .
    else
      .[0:$budget] as $cut
      | ($cut | rindex("\n")) as $idx
      | (if $idx then $cut[0:$idx] else $cut end) + "\n… (truncated)"
    end;

  # Distinct Postgres versions a group occurred on (partition does not matter)
  def pg_versions:
    map(.postgres // "")
    | map(select(. != ""))
    | unique;

  # Up to $n most recent distinct job URLs to find patterns
  def recent_job_urls($n):
    map(select((.job_url // "") != ""))
    | sort_by(.run_id | tonumber? // 0)
    | reverse
    | reduce .[] as $e ([]; if any(.[]; . == $e.job_url) then . else . + [$e.job_url] end)
    | .[0:$n];

  def slack_links($urls):
    if ($urls | length) > 0 then
      "Logs: " + ($urls | to_entries | map("<\(.value)|\(.key + 1)>") | join(" ")) + " · "
    else
      ""
    end;

  def md_links($urls):
    if ($urls | length) > 0 then
      "Logs: " + ($urls | to_entries | map("[\(.key + 1)](\(.value))") | join(" ")) + " · "
    else
      ""
    end;

  # Renders one group as both a Slack section and a step-summary markdown block,
  # shared by the flaky-test and wait-margin sections below - only the headline text
  # (and whether a test name is shown) differs between kinds.
  def render_group:
    . as $g
    | (if ($g.envs | length) > 0 then "  _(seen on: \($g.envs | join(", ")))_" else "" end) as $envs_suffix
    | (if $g.kind == "wait_margin" then "" else "\($g.test)\n" end) as $test_line
    | (if $g.kind == "wait_margin" then "" else "`\($g.test)`\n" end) as $md_test_line
    | ("*\($g.key)* — \($g.count)x\($envs_suffix)\n\(slack_links($g.job_urls))\($test_line)```\n\n```") as $overhead
    | ([50, 2900 - ($overhead | length)] | max) as $budget
    | ($g.snippet | truncate_at_line($budget)) as $snippet
    | {
        slack: {
          type: "section",
          text: { type: "mrkdwn",
            text: "*\($g.key)* — \($g.count)x\($envs_suffix)\n\(slack_links($g.job_urls))\($test_line)```\n\($snippet)\n```" }
        },
        md: "**\($g.key)** — \($g.count)x\($envs_suffix)\n\(md_links($g.job_urls))\($md_test_line)```\n\($snippet)\n```"
      };

  # `wait_margin` events (see WAIT_MARGIN_REPORT in test_helper.exs) are a different
  # phenomenon from a test flake - a wait close to or over its budget, possibly on a
  # fully green run - so they group separately by file:line too, and get their own
  # section further down rather than mixing into the flaky-test counts.
  (group_by(if (.kind // "assertion") == "wait_margin" then "__margin__:" + (.file // "") + ":" + (.line|tostring)
             elif (.file // "") != "" then (.file + ":" + (.line|tostring))
             else .test end)
   | map(
       . as $events
       | ($events[0]) as $first
       | ($events | sort_by(.run_id | tonumber? // 0) | last) as $latest
       | if ($first.kind // "assertion") == "wait_margin" then
           {
             key: ($first.file + ":" + ($first.line|tostring)),
             kind: "wait_margin",
             count: ($events | length),
             snippet: ($latest.snippet // ""),
             job_urls: ($events | recent_job_urls($max_job_links)),
             envs: ($events | pg_versions)
           }
         else
           {
             key: (if ($first.file // "") != "" then ($first.file + ":" + ($first.line|tostring)) else $first.test end),
             kind: "assertion",
             count: ($events | length),
             test: $first.test,
             snippet: ($latest.snippet // ""),
             job_urls: ($events | recent_job_urls($max_job_links)),
             envs: ($events | pg_versions)
           }
         end
     )
  ) as $groups
  | ($groups | map(select(.kind != "wait_margin")) | sort_by(-.count)) as $flaky_groups
  | ($groups | map(select(.kind == "wait_margin")) | sort_by(-.count)) as $margin_groups
  | ($flaky_groups | length) as $total_flaky_groups
  | ($flaky_groups | map(.count) | add // 0) as $total_occurrences
  | ($flaky_groups[0:$max_entries]) as $flaky_shown
  | ($margin_groups[0:$max_margin_entries]) as $margin_shown
  | ($flaky_shown | map(render_group)) as $flaky_rendered
  | ($margin_shown | map(render_group)) as $margin_rendered
  | {
      blocks: (
        (if $total_flaky_groups > 0 then
          [
            { type: "section", text: { type: "mrkdwn",
                text: "*\($total_flaky_groups) distinct flaky test(s), \($total_occurrences) total occurrence(s) today*" } }
          ]
          + ($flaky_rendered | map(.slack))
          + (if $total_flaky_groups > $max_entries then
              [{ type: "context", elements: [ { type: "mrkdwn",
                  text: "…and \($total_flaky_groups - $max_entries) more distinct flaky test location(s) today." } ] }]
            else [] end)
        else [] end)
        + (if ($margin_groups | length) > 0 then
            (if $total_flaky_groups > 0 then [{ type: "divider" }] else [] end)
            + [
                { type: "section", text: { type: "mrkdwn",
                    text: "*⏱️ \($margin_groups | length) wait(s) close to or over budget, \($margin_groups | map(.count) | add) occurrence(s) today*" } }
              ]
            + ($margin_rendered | map(.slack))
            + (if ($margin_groups | length) > $max_margin_entries then
                [{ type: "context", elements: [ { type: "mrkdwn",
                    text: "…and \(($margin_groups | length) - $max_margin_entries) more wait margin location(s) today." } ] }]
              else [] end)
          else [] end)
      ),
      summary: (
        (if $total_flaky_groups > 0 then
          "**\($total_flaky_groups) distinct flaky test(s), \($total_occurrences) total occurrence(s) today**\n\n"
          + ($flaky_rendered | map(.md) | join("\n\n---\n\n"))
          + (if $total_flaky_groups > $max_entries then
              "\n\n…and \($total_flaky_groups - $max_entries) more distinct flaky test location(s) today."
            else "" end)
        else "No flaky test occurrences today." end)
        + (if ($margin_groups | length) > 0 then
            "\n\n---\n\n**⏱️ \($margin_groups | length) wait(s) close to or over budget, \($margin_groups | map(.count) | add) occurrence(s) today**\n\n"
            + ($margin_rendered | map(.md) | join("\n\n---\n\n"))
            + (if ($margin_groups | length) > $max_margin_entries then
                "\n\n…and \(($margin_groups | length) - $max_margin_entries) more wait margin location(s) today."
              else "" end)
          else "" end)
      )
    }
' all_events.jsonl)"

echo "has_events=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "blocks=$(echo "$AGGREGATED_JSON" | jq -c '.blocks')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{
  echo "## Daily flaky test & wait margin digest"
  echo
  echo "$AGGREGATED_JSON" | jq -r '.summary'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Load Docker images from cache
steps.run:
zstd -d --stdout /tmp/docker-images/postgres.tar.zst | docker image load &
PID1=$!
zstd -d --stdout /tmp/docker-images/deno.tar.zst | docker image load &
PID2=$!
wait $PID1 || exit $?
wait $PID2 || exit $?

steps.name: Pull and save Docker images
steps.run:
docker pull ${{ env.POSTGRES_IMAGE }} &
PID1=$!
docker pull ${{ env.DENO_IMAGE }} &
PID2=$!
wait $PID1 || exit $?
wait $PID2 || exit $?
mkdir -p /tmp/docker-images
docker image save ${{ env.POSTGRES_IMAGE }} | zstd -T0 -o /tmp/docker-images/postgres.tar.zst
docker image save ${{ env.DENO_IMAGE }} | zstd -T0 -o /tmp/docker-images/deno.tar.zst

pipelines.name: Security Advisories

steps.name: Run hex audit
steps.run:
# Human readable run for the job log, it also decides whether the job fails.
status=0
mix hex.audit > audit.log 2>&1 || status=$?
cat audit.log

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
  # The SARIF report only contains findings that are not ignored (see
  # ignore_advisories in mix.exs), so the notification only has actionable ones.
  mix hex.audit --format sarif --output audit.sarif || true

  # One Slack section per finding. Compact JSON is a single line, so it is safe to
  # write as a plain `name=value` output.
  blocks=""
  if [ -s audit.sarif ]; then
    blocks="$(jq -c --argjson max 40 '
      # Slack mrkdwn treats & < > as control characters
      def esc: gsub("&"; "&") | gsub("<"; "<") | gsub(">"; ">");
      def severity: if . >= 9 then "CRITICAL" elif . >= 7 then "HIGH" elif . >= 4 then "MEDIUM" else "LOW" end;
      .runs[0] as $run
      | ($run.tool.driver.rules | map({key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $rules
      | [ $run.results[]
          | ($rules[.ruleId].properties["security-severity"]) as $score
          | if $score != null then
              .message.arguments as [$pkg, $version, $advisory, $title, $url]
              | "*\($pkg) \($version)* - <\($url)|\($advisory | esc)> (\($score | tonumber | severity))\n\($title | esc | .[0:2000])"
            else
              (.message.text | esc | .[0:2900])
            end
          | { type: "section", text: { type: "mrkdwn", text: . } } ]
      # Slack allows 50 blocks per message, the rest of the message needs a few
      | if length > $max then
          .[0:$max] + [{ type: "context", elements: [{ type: "mrkdwn", text: "...and \(length - $max) more, see the run log" }] }]
        else . end
    ' audit.sarif || true)"
  fi

  # No SARIF (e.g. the registry could not be fetched): show the plain log instead
  # of a notification without any information.
  if [ -z "$blocks" ] || [ "$blocks" = "[]" ]; then
    blocks="$(sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' audit.log \
      | jq -Rsc '[{ type: "section", text: { type: "mrkdwn", text: ("```" + (gsub("&"; "&") | gsub("<"; "<") | gsub(">"; ">") | .[0:2900]) + "```") } }]')"
  fi
  echo "blocks=${blocks}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

exit "$status"

steps.run:
# Every port but the one the step above already brought up.
ports=()
for port in ${EXTERNAL_TENANT_DB_PORTS//,/ }; do
  [ "$port" = "$TENANT_DB_PORT" ] || ports+=("$port")
done

# Waited on one pid at a time: `wait` with several only reports the last one's status,
# which would let a cluster that never came up fail silently here and confusingly later.
pids=()
for port in "${ports[@]}"; do
  COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="tenant-db-$port" TENANT_DB_PORT="$port" \
    docker compose -f compose.tenant-db.yml up -d --wait --wait-timeout 300 &
  pids+=($!)
done
for pid in "${pids[@]}"; do wait "$pid"; done

for port in "${ports[@]}"; do
  COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME="tenant-db-$port" TENANT_DB_PORT="$port" \
    docker compose -f compose.tenant-db.yml run --rm tenant_db_bootstrap
done

steps.name: Resolve job URL
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
# github.job is the YAML job key ("tests"), not the per-matrix numeric job ID
# the /job/<id> URL needs - resolve it by matching this runner against the run's job
# list (each job in a run gets a distinct runner; RUNNER_NAME is set by the runner).
JOB_ID="$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}/jobs?per_page=100" \
  --paginate --jq ".jobs[] | select(.runner_name == \"$RUNNER_NAME\") | .id" | head -n1)"
if [ -n "$JOB_ID" ]; then
  echo "url=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}/job/${JOB_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Fetch release notes
steps.run:
CURRENT_FULL=$(git show HEAD:assets/package.json | jq -r '.dependencies["@supabase/realtime-js"] // ""' | grep -oP '[\d]+\.[\d]+\.[\d]+(-[\w.]+)?' || true)
if [ -z "$CURRENT_FULL" ]; then
  echo "::error::Could not read the current @supabase/realtime-js version from assets/package.json"
  exit 1
fi
CURRENT_BASE=$(echo "$CURRENT_FULL" | grep -oP '[\d]+\.[\d]+\.[\d]+')
[[ "$CURRENT_FULL" == *"-"* ]] && INCLUDE_CURRENT=true || INCLUDE_CURRENT=false
[[ "$VERSION" == *"-"* ]] && STABLE_ONLY=false || STABLE_ONLY=true
RELEASES=$(gh api "repos/supabase/supabase-js/releases?per_page=100")
RELEASE_NOTES=$(echo "$RELEASES" | jq -r \
  --arg current "v${CURRENT_BASE}" \
  --arg new "v${VERSION}" \
  --argjson stable_only "$STABLE_ONLY" \
  --argjson include_current "$INCLUDE_CURRENT" \
  '[.[] | select(.draft == false) | select(if $stable_only then .prerelease == false else true end)] |
   (map(.tag_name) | index($new)) as $start |
   (map(.tag_name) | index($current)) as $end |
   ($end | if . != null and $include_current then . + 1 else . end) as $end_adj |
   if $start == null then ["Target version not found in last 100 releases."]
   elif $end_adj != null and $start >= $end_adj then ["Downgrade — no release notes available."]
   else [.[$start:$end_adj][] | "## " + .tag_name + "\n\n" + (.body // "No release notes.")]
   end | .[]')
{
  echo "RELEASE_NOTES<<EOF"
  echo "$RELEASE_NOTES"
  echo "EOF"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
